runs.reason: The tool refuses it: no recorded sha256 for its PREREG.md (no sidecar beside it, and no other chain source). Its counts print above, outside the bench rule, with the provenance that does exist.

misses.description: legal@0.1.0 certified a deontic modal swap: 'must' quoted as '[may]' or '[can]' PASSed as an accurate quotation
legal@0.1.0 certified a bracketed antonym: 'preclude' quoted as '[allow]' PASSed
legal@0.1.0 certified an ellipsis eliding a limiting clause ('unless ...', 'provided that ...'), reading a conditional as absolute
peppol 0.2.0's per-line R120 slack let each line net exceed quantity times price by 0.02, so N lines overbilled 0.02 times N with every check PASS (and +0.0201 on one line passed at cent rounding)
misses.fixed_by: FIX-V / peppol-en16931@0.3.0 (summed deviation stated as an advisory under the V3 ruling; the per-line cliff is exactly 0.02)

misses.description: a line priced in another currency, with totals in the invoice currency, PASSes clean: R051 reads one document-level currency
the lenient amount normalizer behind the built-in invoice, pay-app and reconcile rulesets coerces garbled amounts ('$1OO.O0' to 1, '°225.0' to 225)
misses.fixed_by: T2-B / engine 0.6.0 (built-in invoice, pay-app and reconcile read text amounts strictly: a garbled amount is UNPARSEABLE, never coerced and never defaulted; verdicts of engines up to 0.5.0 replay as they read)

misses.description: abstain as evasion: one non-numeric character on a failing operand turned FAIL into PASS-WITH-OPEN, and no FAIL was recorded against the vendor
misses.fixed_by: FIX-V / engine 0.2.0 (HELD-SUSPECT), re-ruled by V1b / engine 0.3.0 (struck as suspect, counted, gate OPEN)

misses.description: a fifth VAT breakdown row with any wrong amount made BR-CO-14 abstain, so a VAT error could hide across five rows
misses.fixed_by: FIX-V / peppol-en16931@0.3.0 (every VAT row read as a list)

misses.description: verdict_id and input_hash did not bind the remedy text: a doctored remedy on a FAIL replayed VERIFIED, and two different bundles shared one verdict id
misses.fixed_by: FIX-V / engine 0.2.0 (remedy_table_hash in the verdict id; replay re-derives remedies from the pinned ruleset)

misses.description: a dissent's sentence is certified as appearing verbatim in the opinion: holding, concurrence, dissent and reported argument are not distinguished
the attest monitor matched an undated model alias to any dated snapshot, including a fabricated future one, so a snapshot switch under one alias was hidden
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-04 / the attest monitor requires a dated snapshot to name a real calendar date no later than its reply, records the resolved snapshot as evidence, and names a snapshot change under one declaration (receipts test coh3-attest-snapshot)

misses.description: R051 flipped to FAIL on a Cyrillic 'Е' in 'ЕUR': cross-script confusables are not folded
a zero-width space inside an identifier flipped the verdict (whitespace matching missed U+200B)
misses.fixed_by: FIX-V / engine 0.2.0 (NFKC; invisible format characters and every kind of space removed)

misses.description: the amount reader guessed the locale by position: '1.234' read 1234, a space-grouped '1 234' read 1 (truncated), '1,23' read 1.23
misses.fixed_by: T2-B / engine 0.6.0 (invoice, pay-app and reconcile: an ambiguous grouping reads only in the document's declared number_locale or the format its own unambiguous numbers settle, else UNPARSEABLE; a space group reads only under a declared fr; the declarative path reads so since engine 0.2.0 unless a ruleset sets strict_numbers false)

misses.description: a trailing space in a key or a no-break space in a value made the field absent, a silent downgrade to PASS-WITH-OPEN
misses.fixed_by: T2-B / engine 0.6.0 (invoice, pay-app and reconcile: a key that differs from its path only by spaces or invisible characters is UNPARSEABLE, naming the key, and a refused value is never read as 0; a no-break space inside a number is unreadable; keys are scanned in the document under check, not in contract, evidence or history references; the declarative path names such keys since engine 0.2.0)

misses.description: with the single-writer lock off (the plain CLI and MCP stdio paths), eight concurrent writers forked and corrupted the chain
misses.fixed_by: FIX-R / receipts per-append lock by default

misses.description: an agent could hold a peer and renew the hold with no cap, starving one target forever
misses.fixed_by: T4c / custody hold renewal cap per lineage

misses.description: replay accepted a tampered document.producer (flagged, not re-performed) and an omitted remedies array (VERIFIED, unflagged)
misses.fixed_by: 2026-10-05 / replay refuses a bundle without its remedies by default
